scope: FacetWP destination relationship sources confirmed from uploaded class-post-connections.php.

relationshipFacetSources.likelyFromToInterpretation: destination values are used as FacetWP filter values for indexed accommodation content
relationshipFacetSources.ownershipBoundary: core destination facet source for a confirmed core post type

facetwpIndexingBehaviour.customFieldArrayExpansion: The generic _to_ custom-field branch expands array values, resolves facet display values via get_the_title(), and skips default indexing by inserting rows directly.
facetwpIndexingBehaviour.hierarchyAugmentation: Confirmed for destination_to_tour and destination_to_accommodation only.
facetwpIndexingBehaviour.htmlRendering: destination_facet_html routes this source to destination_facet_render() when the facet source matches the sources array.
facetwpIndexingBehaviour.fselectCountBehaviour: Facet counts are disabled for fselect facets using this source.

destinationHierarchyBehaviour.countryRegionDepthWithoutContinentFilter: When hierarchy augmentation runs, top-level destination values use depth 0 and child destinations use depth 1.
destinationHierarchyBehaviour.continentCountryRegionDepthWithContinent: When engine_search_continent_filter is enabled and hierarchy augmentation runs, continent rows are depth 0, top-level country destinations depth 1, and region/child destinations depth 2.
destinationHierarchyBehaviour.parentIdHandling: Parent IDs are derived from wp_get_post_parent_id() for destination values; continent parent IDs are term IDs added when enable_search_continent_filter is enabled.

continentFilteringBehaviour.behaviour: When enabled for augmented sources, continent terms are added as additional facet rows and country destination rows receive parent_id values pointing to continent term IDs.

relationshipFacetSources.sourceConfidence: confirmed source key and indexing behaviour; inferred relationship direction from source name

globalRules: Treat relationship/facet sources as evidence of FacetWP behaviour, not proof that every referenced entity is core-owned.
Only tour, destination and accommodation are confirmed core post types from the uploaded post type JSON files.
review, special, vehicle and activity remain extension-facing or unknown until their registration source is inspected.

facetFieldNormalisation.behaviour: strips non-numeric characters except dots, trims leading dots, and uses the cleaned value as the FacetWP facet value/display value
facetFieldNormalisation.safetyNote: Use as FacetWP indexing behaviour only; do not treat the string price field as structured currency data without parsing rules.

facetFieldNormalisation.behaviour: strips non-numeric characters except spaces, splits on spaces, and uses the first token as the FacetWP facet value/display value
facetFieldNormalisation.safetyNote: Use as FacetWP indexing behaviour only; do not treat the string duration field as a complete structured duration model.

renderingRules.fselectCountBehaviour: Facet counts are disabled for fselect facets using the listed destination relationship sources.
